'''TY-KO''' was a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] that was stationed at [[Sentinel Outpost]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Galactic War]].

==Behind the scenes==
TY-KO was introduced in Game Update 1.1 of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a reference to the webcomic Penny Arcade, which ran a strip where one of its main characters&mdash;Tycho&mdash;expressed his desire to play as an archaeologist protocol droid named "TY-KO" instead of as a Sith or a bounty hunter.
